implementation_scope: Phase-A target preparation only; no SAT backend, long n59 census, relation collection, discrete-log recovery, or key material
claim_boundary: This protocol can create a balanced, class-stratified public toy PDP panel. It cannot establish natural class prevalence from the 50/50 sample, an end-to-end index-calculus result, cryptanalytic key recovery, or a SOTA claim.

master_seed_derivation.input_encoding: ASCII KOBLITZ-BALANCED-PDP-v1 followed by one zero byte followed by the raw 32-byte Stage13 panel-summary SHA-256

target_population.definition: All affine points E(F_(2^n)) excluding infinity
target_population.sampler: BLAKE3 keyed domain-separated draws of n uniform x bits and one selector bit; reject nonlifting x; for x != 0 select the canonically y-sorted lift; for x = 0 accept the unique lift only for selector zero
target_population.receipt: record draw cap, draws examined, accepted affine draws, decode/decomposable/duplicate rejection counts, selected count, and SHA-256 of the accepted LE64(x)||LE64(y) stream

classification.oracle: complete exact m=3 factor-base sumset census
classification.tuple_policy: canonical indices i <= j <= k with repetition allowed
classification.infinity_policy: retain infinity during pair arithmetic and exclude it only from the affine target sumset
classification.operation_identity: group additions must equal B(B+1)/2 + B(B+1)(B+2)/6 before exhaustive is true
classification.digest_encoding: sort point keys in numeric lexicographic (x,y) order, then hash concatenated LE64(x)||LE64(y) records with SHA-256
classification.independent_replay: a second flat-vector materialization sharing neither the primary pair cache nor its hash table must reproduce the exact distinct count and digest
classification.selected_witness_validation: re-sum every selected decomposable witness and require exact affine target equality
classification.decomposable_selection: bottom-20 target-level keyed priorities after sumset deduplication
classification.nondecomposable_selection: first 20 distinct unconditional affine draws absent from the complete sumset
classification.large_census_guard: preparation requires an explicit --max-canonical-triples ceiling checked before the output directory is created

blinding.presentation_order: independent target-derived BLAKE3 priority across all selected cells
blinding.source_nonce: Each blind instance contains a target-derived class-blind u64 used in the legacy exporter seed position and bound with the opaque id and target mode by the explicit-target v2 source identity
blinding.negation_orbit_policy: P and -P remain distinct uniformly sampled affine targets, but the blind source_system_id binds their common x-only source system and is the mandatory bootstrap cluster key
blinding.solver_access_boundary: Only blind/ may be supplied to solver processes; sealed-oracle/ remains withheld until solver artifacts are frozen

phase_a: Every cell reproduces its frozen factor-point and affine-population counts
Every sumset receipt reports exhaustive canonical pair and triple counts
Every decomposable target has a validated exact factor-point witness
Every nondecomposable target is absent from the complete affine sumset
Each cell has exactly 20 entries of each class in the sealed oracle
The blind bundle contains 160 unique opaque ids and none of the forbidden fields
The blind and oracle files are independently hashed by the seal
stop_conditions: A selected cell exceeds the explicit canonical-triple ceiling
A frozen geometry or population count differs
Either class contains fewer than 20 distinct targets
Any oracle field appears in the blind bundle
